What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card lists an open-source code repository on GitHub (https://github.com/microsoft/Phi-4-vision). It also links a GitHub repo (https://github.com/microsoft/phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B). It points to a data card (DATACARD.md) for training data information. It says evaluation logs will be released publicly (a future release). The card does not say the repository contains training or inference code. It does not say the training data itself is released.
quotes: Public access through open-source code repositories: [GitHub](https://github.com/microsoft/Phi-4-vision)
To learn more about the training data used for Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision-15B please refer to the full data card: https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B/blob/main/DATACARD.md.
Evaluation logs will be released publicly.
